mechanism: Economy producer (Sunflower role). Never attacks. Every 14 s it pops out a collectible Rice Gem worth 50 sun near itself. The 1.2 s anticipation squash/quiver/glow telegraphs each payout. Purely defensive value: protects its tile only by having HP.
name: Sacred Rice
subtitle: Sacred Jewel Rice
